features.title: Release notes in About
features.text: Settings → About lists the main features of each release, newest first.

features.title: Jump to a plugin's details
features.text: Radarr and Sonarr show a status capsule at the top of the card that jumps to their section, which now always says when a film is out digitally and on disc.

features.title: Plugin sections on the card
features.text: Radarr and Sonarr show their status and dates on the card: when the digital release is due, the next episode, and where the download stands.

features.title: Split Add button
features.text: The main part adds a screenshot or link as before; the small arrow opens the menu for movies, TV shows and books.

features.title: Add movies, TV shows and books by name
features.text: Search by title, pick the right one from a list, and Magpie fills in the poster, ratings and links. No screenshot needed.

features.title: Activity tray
features.text: A stack at the bottom shows every analysis, re-analysis and refresh as it runs and how it ended; finished rows fade or can be dismissed.

features.title: Download status for Radarr and Sonarr
features.text: After adding, see whether it is downloaded, downloading (with a percentage), pending or missing.

features.title: Smoother settings
features.text: Saving shows a message and closes the panel; connection tests show success or failure inline; root folder and quality profile are drop-downs.

features.title: Better covers
features.text: Wide pictures get a blurred backdrop instead of awkward bars; logos stay crisp on a plain background.

features.title: About shows the real version
features.text: One About panel in Settings, with the version of the running server.

features.title: Plugins
features.text: Extend Magpie: built-in Radarr and Sonarr to send saved films and shows to your download list, plus plugins installed from a git repository or a single file.

features.title: Duplicate detection
features.text: Saving the same screenshot or link twice merges into the existing card.

features.title: Deploy and release scripts
features.text: deploy.sh and tag.sh update, tag and restart the server.

features.title: GitHub links become repositories
features.text: An item whose own link is a GitHub repository is filed as one, with stars, language and README picture.

features.title: More reliable article links
features.text: Magpie finds an article's exact address more reliably.

features.title: Gemini web search
features.text: Gemini models can search the web with Google Search grounding.

features.title: Conversation logs and debug mode
features.text: See what was sent to the AI models and what came back, one log per operation.

features.title: Finds the repo and the article
features.text: For every AI provider, with more related links: repositories, packages, apps, papers and companies.

features.title: Per-model rate limits
features.text: A rate-limited model pauses and retries instead of failing.

features.title: Screenshots identified for you
features.text: Save screenshots of recommendations; Magpie identifies them with AI and OCR and looks up posters, covers, ratings and links.

features.title: Offline library
features.text: An installable app that works offline and syncs when the server is back; search across everything you saved.
